Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionThe HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, learn Western riding, test your skills, and claim the crown at the big Western riding tournament! Dive into a lovingly crafted world and explore the adventurous surroundings at your own pace. Experience a charming, engaging story full of humor. In addition to classic riding disciplines like barrel racing and pole bending, you can also test your skills in activities such as archery, painting, and playing the guitar. Six unique horses are waiting to be ridden – each with its own character and traits that you can develop throughout the game. Create your own style for you and your horse with numerous customization options and a wide selection of carefully designed color combinations. All of this is accompanied by an atmospheric original soundtrack composed by Grammy®-winning musician Winifred Phillips. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionWelcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighborhood! Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone. Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play. The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street! Push, pull and trade places with objects to reach the end of each level! Create bridges by pushing minecarts or boxes into lakes, and navigate objects within complex railroad systems! Buttons, boxes, minecarts, magical crystals, rails - there are too many objects and possible interactions to count! But don't worry, levels don't have a time limit and you can even skip the ones you think are too hard.
